services.name: Swim Lessons
services.desc: At Evolution Swim Academy, we offer a structured swimming curriculum with five swim safety levels and three stroke technique levels. These programs are designed to help children become safer and more confident swimmers. By completing all of our swim lesson plans, your child will develop a strong foundation in the four major swimming strokes: freestyle, backstroke, breaststroke, and butterfly. We understand that repetition is key to mastering swim safety and stroke technique. Our lessons focus on consistent practice, ensuring that students repeat each essential skill until they demonstrate mastery. services.name: Safety Lessons
services.desc: Evolution Swim Academy offers five swim safety learning levels. When your child has successfully completed all lesson plans, you can be assured that he/she will be a safer and more confident swimmer. Children learn best through repetition and while in our safety swim lesson plans, our students will repeat the skills within each plan until we feel that they have mastered the skills necessary to move up to the next learning level. This will assure that our students retain the skills learned and the natural progression in our curriculum will make it easier for our students to transition from one level to the next.
